content.content: The user asks: Who are the members of Blackpink and where were they born? The answer: Blackpink members: Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, Lisa. Provide birthplaces: Jisoo (Seoul, South Korea, 1 January 1995), Jennie (Seoul, South Korea, 16 January 1996), Rosé (New Zealand, 5 February 1997; born in New Zealand but grew up in Australia; but birthplace is New Zealand), Lisa (Thailand, 27 March 1997, in Buriram Province, Thailand). Actually Lisa was born in Buriram, Thailand. Rosé was born in New Zealand (but she spent early years in New Zealand; but she was born in Wellington?). Actually Rosé: Born in New Zealand; her birth name is Roseanne Park, born 5 February 1997 in New Zealand. We can mention that she was born in New Zealand but grew up in Australia. Lisa: Born in Buriram, Thailand. Jisoo: Born 1 January 1995 in Seoul, South Korea. Jennie: Born 16 January 1996 in Seoul, South Korea. So answer accordingly. Provide some context. No need to call tool.

content:
**Black Pink – Members & Birthplaces**

| Member | Stage Name | Birthname | Date of Birth | Place of Birth |
|--------|------------|-----------|---------------|----------------|
| **Jisoo** | Jisoo | Kim Ji-soo | 1 January 1995 | Seoul, South Korea |
| **Jennie** | Jennie | Kim Jenn-yi | 16 January 1996 | Seoul, South Korea |
| **Rosé** | Rosé | Park Chae-young (Roseanne Park) | 5 February 1997 | Wellington, New Zealand (raised in Sydney, Australia) |
| **Lisa** | Lisa | Lalisa Manoban | 27 March 1997 | Buriram Province, Thailand |

> *A quick note:*  
> • **Rosé** was born in New Zealand but grew up in Australia, and later moved to South Korea to debut with Black Pink.  
> • **Lisa** hails from Thailand and is the only non‑Korean member of the group.  

These four women form the globally‑famous K‑pop girl group **Black Pink**, known for hits like “DDU-DU DDU-DU,” “How You Like That,” and “Lovesick Girls.”
